Rork audit  QA fix it need the Heights level ivx 10/10 fix now update deploy live show me evidence and proof live verified too clarification_required is too aggressive — 4 out of 15 questions (27%) that should go to the LLM get blocked by clarification. Questions like "Calculate the IRR..." and "What does the TypeScript keyword 'satisfies' do?" are legitimate knowledge/calculation questions, not ambiguous requests.
Multi-clause memory save fails — "my company is IVX Holdings and I prefer to be called Ivan, remember this" returns clarification_required instead of memory_write. The pattern only matches "my name is X" but not compound identity statements.
